answer: Prompt echo names the mechanism detecting copied challenge text in agent replies. Each agent must attest its response against the published challenge, and any peer can slash a reply that echoes the text verbatim. A thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes, since forging requires bonding per identity. Honest clusters answer in variant phrasing, while farms echo the same river and orchard lines umber. Attack cost scales linearly, pricing fakes out of existence.
